channel.title: Kiki Updates
channel.description: Developer ID signed and notarized updates for Kiki.

item.description:
# Kiki 0.6.3
- Centers the numbered Guided Review badges precisely inside their circular controls. - Expands Suggestions from Recent Edits across the Personalization Studio so the original text, replacement, and application columns remain visible without horizontal scrolling. - Lets users edit an existing voice snippet by selecting it, changing its trigger or inserted text, and choosing Update Snippet. - Makes Personalization action rows symmetrical with equal-width, equal-height buttons across Snippets, Private Apps, and Confidence Reviews. - Adds regression coverage for guided-step alignment, full-width suggestion layout, snippet editing, and action-row geometry.

# Kiki 0.6.2
- Refines Kiki’s Studio Hardware interface with clearer hierarchy, reusable empty states, persistent field labels, improved disabled-control contrast, and matching light/dark layouts. - Rebuilds Personalization Studio around guided, selection-aware workflows for learning, vocabulary, voice snippets, private apps, and confidence reviews. - Adds a guided speaker-identification workflow that can rename one generated speaker label everywhere or assign selected transcript rows to the correct person. - Improves History and Custom Dictionary with informative empty states, clear selection-dependent actions, and immediate status feedback. - Improves Meeting Mode and audio-file transcription with clearer local-processing states, safer export/copy availability, and plain-text, Markdown, rich-text, and PDF export choices. - Adds packaged preview coverage and regression diagnostics for the new workflows, real control hit testing, and disabled-button readability.

# Kiki 0.6.1
- Applies the Templeton Slate color palette in light and dark appearances while preserving the established Studio Hardware graphics, geometry, spacing, and controls. - Uses warm cream for primary text and the active model selector, with sage reserved for highlights and status accents. - Improves disabled Studio Hardware button readability and adds diagnostics against the real Models and Meeting controls. - Clarifies the menu-bar dictation action: Kiki records locally, then inserts the transcription into the current app.

# Kiki 0.6.0
- Adds Kiki Checkup for microphone selection, live input, permissions, local-model readiness, shortcut verification, and a guided first dictation. - Adds exact Undo Last Dictation and memory-only Retry Last Dictation, with verification that Kiki removes only its unchanged insertion. - Adds Private Session, which pauses history, correction learning, confidence review, and optional Pawprints while keeping undo audio only in memory. - Adds Read Selection in My Voice, which prefills Voice Studio for review without generating automatically. - Adds opt-in, aggregate-only Pawprints and privacy-safe support bundles containing no transcripts, recordings, clipboard contents, personal names, or file paths. - Improves public-release diagnostics, native control hit testing, Command-A routing, and the final Checkup layout with uniform high-contrast Studio Hardware buttons.

# Kiki 0.5.17
- Rebuilds the waveform as a fixed 30 fps scrolling history of real microphone loudness instead of replacing all 38 bars with every incoming audio chunk. - Preserves 37 prior bars per frame and appends one new RMS-derived level, eliminating the jumping, stuttering pattern while keeping the display audio-driven. - Calibrates the meter against the saved real-voice reference recording on this Mac rather than synthetic test tones. - Keeps normal recorded speech centered around a restrained visual range with substantial headroom for genuinely forceful speech. - Adds a packaged real-voice regression diagnostic that checks both raw levels and the final rendered waveform against saturation limits.
